name: Bad
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively depart from evil and pursue goodness and peace, emphasizing the importance of fearing the Lord as a safeguard against turning to harmful paths. Wisdom is gained by avoiding bad company and counsel, as walking with fools leads to destruction, while the fear of the Lord extends life and well-being. The Bible warns that what may seem right to man can ultimately lead to death, underscoring the need for divine guidance to navigate bad attitudes, bad days, and difficult relationships rightly.
